question: What's new on Raymond James in the last 90 days?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James, as it ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors, has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year.
items.quote: As Raymond James ended its fiscal year with a record 8,943 advisors - a 2% increase year-over-year, the firm has signaled it expects continued momentum, with healthy pipelines of advisor commitments heading into the coming year.

items.text: Raymond James 's CEO Paul Shoukry said the firm does look for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but it would have to be a good cultural and strategic fit; the firm does acquisitions to grow revenues, not to slash costs, and financially it has to make sense for Raymond James and the sellers.
items.quote: When asked about M&A, Shoukry said the firm does look for acquisitions in the wealth management business in particular, but it would have to be a good cultural and strategic fit. "We don't do acquisitions to slash costs," he said. "We do acquisitions to grow revenues and to be better firms together over time. And then of course, financially, it has to make sense for Raymond James and the sellers and everyone involved."

items.text: Raymond James CEO Paul Shoukry has emphasized the firm's strategy of building its advisory ranks through individualized recruitment rather than large-scale acquisitions, evaluating each prospective advisor on a one-on-one basis.
items.quote: Shoukry has emphasized the firm's strategy of building its advisory ranks through individualized recruitment rather than large-scale acquisitions, noting that the firm evaluates each prospective advisor on a one-on-one basis.

cells.reason: The passages contain forward-looking statements from Raymond James executives about adviser pipeline momentum, M&A approach, and recruitment strategy.
